computer remote add: save a computer as a remote

Usage: computer [-c NAME] remote add NAME URL --token cct_…

Checks the token against the computer's agent API and saves the remote in
remotes.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/container-computer, default
~/.config/container-computer; mode 0600). URL is the computer's address, like
https://host/alice. Tokens come from the computer's Agents tab. The first
remote becomes the default.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  local name for the remote (letters, digits, . _ -)
  URL        string      required  the computer's URL, e.g. https://host/alice

Options:
  --token TOKEN        agent token (cct_…); defaults to $COMPUTER_TOKEN

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  computer remote add alice https://computers.example.com/alice --token cct_…

Where: on this machine (no remote needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
